title: Chicken Taco Soup for Two
description: This quick, easy chicken taco soup for two recipe is made with frozen corn and fire-roasted tomatoes. Use rotisserie chicken to save even more time.
ingredients: 0.5 (14 ounce) can fire-roasted diced tomatoes, with juice
1 (5 ounce) boneless, skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced on the diagonal
0.25 cup shredded Oaxaca cheese, or to taste
2 tablespoons sour cream, or to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a heavy saucepan over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add onion and 1 ½ tablespoons taco seasoning; cook and stir until onion is soft and translucent, 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in chicken broth, tomatoes with juice, and corn.
Sprinkle remaining 1 ½ tablespoons taco seasoning over chicken pieces; stir into soup. Cover; cook until chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Serve soup with tortilla chips, avocado slices, Oaxaca cheese, and sour cream.
